# Generated by autogatus. DO NOT EDIT.
# Source of truth is the gatus.* labels + monitored containers.
# endpoints: 2  external-endpoints: 11  |  rendered: <stamp>
endpoints:
- name: api
  group: probed
  url: tcp://probed:9
  interval: 60s
  conditions:
  - '[CONNECTED] == true'
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: api is down
- name: site
  group: web
  url: http://web:80/health
  interval: 60s
  conditions:
  - '[STATUS] == 200'
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: site is down
external-endpoints:
- name: web
  group: apps
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: web (apps)
- name: crashy
  group: crashy
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: crashy (crashy)
- name: fresh
  group: fresh
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
- name: optout-ping
  group: optout
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 45s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: optout-ping check
- name: pauser
  group: pauser
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: pauser (pauser)
- name: quiet
  group: quiet
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
- name: restarter
  group: restarter
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
  alerts:

    description: restarter (restarter)
- name: skipme-port
  group: skipme
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 45s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: skipme-port check
- name: sleepy
  group: sleepy
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: sleepy (sleepy)
- name: structured
  group: structured
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    failure-threshold: 5
    send-on-resolved: true
    description: structured (structured)
- name: worker
  group: worker
  token: tok
  heartbeat:
    interval: 90s
  alerts:
  - type: custom
    description: worker (worker)
